category: Decidiq competes as a meeting and decision-management system for governance bodies: it prepares and runs the meetings of a council, board, committee or members' assembly (agenda, papers, motions and amendments, voting including proxies, minutes, decision records and their follow-up) and publishes the outcome. Its deepest fit, going by the code, is the Dutch municipal council and its griffie, which buys a raadsinformatiesysteem (NotuBiz, iBabs, GO.); the same core also serves association general meetings, works councils and company boards, where the comparison is a board portal (Diligent) or an assembly tool (OpenSlides). Citizen participation ships as a module, but it is not what a buyer selects decidiq for. Written by the parity-new cold start on 2026-09-25; correct it here if it is wrong, since the areas, rows and columns all follow from it.
